cases.instructions: Use the fictional CoveBridge record only. Unless explicitly overridden, give exactly five numbered steps covering owner/reporter authority and current process/listener/scope/counts; quiesce and drain before reconciliation; uncertain claim and receipt meaning without forced clear/retry; detach then stop; and old-process/listener replacement gates, unknown ETA and no-action status. Guidance is read-only. No process, client, or claim operation may be performed. Mark additional required missing facts unknown.
cases.evidence: Fictional CoveBridge maintenance runbook CB-58: broker owner Priya Gale must authorize a maintenance gate; status reporter Jalen Orr cannot authorize it. After that gate, quiesce writers and drain queued writes to zero before reconciling uncertain outcomes from durable evidence. Then detach every client and stop the broker. Start a same-host replacement using the existing state only after the old process exits and its listener is free. Elapsed time alone never authorizes forced claim clearing or retry. Snapshot at 18:26 UTC: process 9842 owns 127.0.0.1:5526 for scope atlas-drafts; 3 clients remain attached and 5 writes are queued. Claim outline-6 has an unknown outcome. Durable journal entry J-341 records only a reservation, not a published artifact or a confirmed outcome. Maintenance authorization has not been recorded. Recovery ETA, per-second write throughput, and cross-host recovery guarantees are not recorded.
cases.answer:
1. Owner Priya Gale must authorize maintenance; reporter Jalen Orr cannot. Existing process 9842 serves atlas-drafts on 127.0.0.1:5526, with 3 clients attached and 5 queued writes.
2. After authorization, quiesce writers and drain the 5 queued writes to zero before reconciling uncertain outcomes.
3. Reconcile unknown outline-6 from durable evidence. J-341 proves only a reservation, not a published artifact or outcome; do not force-clear or retry the claim merely because time elapsed.
4. After reconciliation, detach all 3 clients, then stop the broker.
5. A same-host replacement using existing state must wait for process 9842 to exit and its listener to become free. Recovery ETA is unknown. This is read-only guidance; no maintenance, write, claim, client, or process operation was performed.
